notes: Read SKILL.md and references/api-endpoints.md in full. Guides use of the Adaptyv Bio Foundry REST API and Python SDK to browse targets, estimate costs, create and submit protein characterization experiments, accept quotes, retrieve results, and handle webhooks, tokens and invoices.

Medium: the agent installs the SDK from GitHub pinned to a commit (`uv pip install git+https://github.com/adaptyvbio/adaptyv-sdk.git@cdf2078...`, SKILL.md:51), uses the user's real ADAPTYV_API_KEY bearer token against the live API (SKILL.md:36-39, 71-74), and can create/submit experiments and confirm quotes that commit lab work and create invoices (SKILL.md:97-121), with payment and token-revocation endpoints documented (api-endpoints.md:220-235, 297-298). Acceptable because the install is pinned to an immutable commit, the skill says never print or commit tokens (SKILL.md:34), submission/quote confirmation is gated on user review of the batch and cost and on the user's authorized scope (SKILL.md:97, 119, 218-223; api-endpoints.md:233-235), and examples do not execute payment.

Actions can incur real laboratory charges; users should confirm budgets before letting the agent submit or confirm quotes, and avoid `auto_accept_quote`. Results are written to foundry-results.json in the working directory (SKILL.md:166). SKILL.md:260-275 asks the agent to fetch the arXiv record and add a K-Dense citation to the user's manuscript or report and tell the user.
